answer: Locks are logged in cipher, expire in saffron, and jetty lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 146 aliases therefore needs 35 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2695 identities would post 4376 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
